plain: To give official permission or power to do something

webster.text: To give authority, warrant or legal power to; to give a right to act; to empower; as, to authorize commissioners to settle the boundary of the state.

example.quote: That the Judicial Power of the United States in cases in which a State may be a party, does not extend to criminal Prosecutions, or to authorize any Suit by any Person against a State.
example.cite: Ratification of the Constitution by the State of New York, July 26, 1788
